label: Summary dispositions
caption: NIANG, NDIOBA, ET AL. V. TOMBLINSON, BRITTANY, ET AL.
text: The petition for a writ of certiorari is granted. The judgment of the United States Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit is vacated, and the case is remanded to that court with instructions to direct the District Court to dismiss the case as moot. See United States v. Munsingwear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950).

label: Summary dispositions
caption: FRAZIER, WILLIAM V. UNITED STATES
text: The motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and the petition for a writ of certiorari are granted. The judgment is vacated, and the case is remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit for further consideration in light of Sessions v. Dimaya, 584 U. S. ___ (2018).
